courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
related.transfer: 可遷移「一次加載模型的假想內力」與「施工測量的溫度效應修正」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築差異縮短補償的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fictitious forces from one-step loading" and "Temperature correction of construction surveys" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機；高層建築差異縮短補償則以預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states; Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings centres on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「一次加載與逐層加載」與「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築差異縮短補償，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “One-step versus staged loading” and “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
history.text: 施工階段的結構問題很早就受到注意：1963 年 Grundy 與 Kabaila 分析了多層支撐樓板在施工中承受的荷重，柱縮短研究則在 1960 年代末隨高樓興起。ASCE 37 在 2002 年首次把施工期荷載系統化，EN 1991-1-6 於 2005 年發布施工期作用的歐洲規範。電腦分析進步後，逐層啟動構件與時間相依材料的施工階段分析成為超高層的常規工作：中央電視台總部以五天監測決定兩塔接合時機，碎片大廈以由上而下方式讓核心與地下室同時推進，樂天世界塔延後外伸臂接合，威利斯大樓則在營運中完成底座改造。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Structural problems during construction were recognised early: in 1963 Grundy and Kabaila analysed the loads on slabs in multi-level shoring, and column-shortening studies followed as high-rises grew in the late 1960s. ASCE 37 first systematised construction loads in 2002, and EN 1991-1-6 on actions during execution was published in 2005. As computing advanced, staged analysis activating members floor by floor with time-dependent materials became routine for supertall towers: CCTV Headquarters used five days of monitoring to time the joining of its two towers, The Shard advanced its core and basement simultaneously by top-down construction, Lotte World Tower delayed its outrigger connections, and Willis Tower completed a base repositioning while occupied. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
